summary: Frontend-only regression for Embedded for Kids. Executed 17 e2e flows via Playwright against the preview URL. 16/17 pass. Onboarding (fresh + skip), sidebar hamburger collapse (icon rail with curriculum/playground/donation), header live search (matches + click clears + empty state), header + sidebar donation modals, profile popover with name and reset->onboarding, playground summary with challenge/discovery strips, playground detail mount, tutorial Do/See/Break/Understand tabs, code panel line click with Indonesian explanation, copy code button, simulation run/reset (virtual serial populated then cleared), hardware mode (serial panel renders, status DISCONNECTED), back navigation, and mobile menu overlay at 400x800 all pass. No console/page errors observed.
action_items: (Optional) Sidebar lesson-item testids currently use pattern 'lesson-{lessonId}' (e.g. lesson-1) which collides with other lesson-* testids on the content area (lesson-title, lesson-intro, lesson-status, lesson-context, lesson-article, lesson-content). Consider renaming to 'lesson-link-{id}' or 'sidebar-lesson-{id}' for clearer test targeting; the review request itself mentioned 'lesson link' semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: SerialPanel.jsx was missing data-testid='serial-status' on the connection status span (referenced in the test spec). Added by testing agent.

useWebSerial reports supported=true even in headless preview (navigator.serial exists in some Chromium builds); the 'serial-unsupported' warning may therefore never render in this environment. Functional, but confirm behaviour on user browsers.
Multiple 'lesson-*' data-testids overlap between Sidebar entries and CurriculumContent content region, which can cause ambiguous selectors in automated tests.
test_credentials: N/A - localStorage-only profile. Used name='Kaya', placement='Beginner'.
seed_data_creation: None (localStorage cleared before each onboarding test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 requested flows verified against https://iot-academy-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Added missing data-testid='serial-status' to SerialPanel. If retesting curriculum lesson click, use selector [data-testid^='lesson-'] scoped inside [data-testid='curriculum-sidebar'] or use exact id like [data-testid='lesson-1'] after clicking [data-testid='curriculum-toggle-0'].
